member.name: T:Text.Str
member.summary: Provides static utility methods for string analysis and manipulation.
member.remarks: The Str class contains static methods for performing common string operations. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance of the class.

member.name: M:Text.Str.UniqueChar(System.String)
member.summary: Returns the index of the first non-repeating character in the given string.
member.remarks: This method scans the string to count occurrences of each character, then returns the index of the first character whose count equals one. The method uses a dictionary to store character counts before performing a linear scan to find the first unique character. If the string is null or empty, or if all characters repeat, the method returns -1.
member.param: The input string to search. If null or empty, returns -1.
member.returns: The zero-based index of the first unique character, or -1 if none exists.
